definitions: An increase in salary or wages.
An act of lifting or moving something to a higher position.
An increase in the amount of something, such as prices or taxes.
A hand of cards in poker where a player increases the previous bet.
examples: She got a significant raise this year.
The raise of the flag marked the start of the ceremony.
There was a raise in the cost of living.
He made a raise, putting pressure on the other players.
